shapeSummary: 60 mm diameter, 6 mm thick steel flywheel disk with its axis along Y and its bottom face at Y=0. It has a 14 mm central bore, four 4.2 mm through holes on the diagonals at about 24 mm radius, and four 4.2 mm through holes at about 12 mm radius around the bore.
warnings: Thickness of 6 mm is estimated from the 115 g weight, not stated.
Bore diameter, hole diameters and hole positions are rough estimates from the render.
Counterbores on the outer holes are omitted because their depth and diameter are unknown.
Hex pockets around the inner holes are omitted as uncertain.
The keyed or notched center bore profile is omitted; the bore is modeled as a plain circle.
Logo and engraved ring marks are not modeled.
